purpose: Recover and consolidate decision-relevant evidence for the production auto transcription path without restoring deleted benchmark dumps or changing runtime behavior.

inference_cleanup_equivalence.note: The BasicPitchEngine blob is identical. The current transcribe_audio call still passes the same thresholds to basic_pitch.inference.predict, and the conservative cleanup constants/rules remain the same. Unrelated music_features.py refactors changed the file blob.

metric_semantics.note_f1: legacy strict pitch plus onset plus offset within fixed 50 ms
metric_semantics.comparability_note: The current canonical evaluator uses mir_eval with a 50 ms minimum offset tolerance plus the standard 20% reference-duration tolerance. Therefore the legacy note_f1 values below are intentionally retained under their original stricter semantics and are not silently relabeled as current canonical note_f1.

cleanup_ablation.decision: Production cleanup is a no-op on these guitar/full-mix clips; do not add cleanup heuristics to address the measured domain failure.

threshold_sweep.decision: Do not change production thresholds from this evidence: gains are marginal, the preferred frame threshold differs by domain, and full-mix quality remains poor.

slakh_task_standard.corpus: Five fixed 30-second Slakh2100-redux test excerpts with per-source MIDI truth.
slakh_task_standard.metric_semantics: mir_eval 0.8.2 maximum bipartite matching; 50 ms onset, 50 cents, offset max(50 ms, 20% reference duration).

source_separation_legacy_strict.pipeline: Demucs htdemucs 4.0.1 plus Basic Pitch 0.5/0.3 on five 20-second BabySlakh mixtures.
source_separation_legacy_strict.decision: Do not make source separation mandatory for general transcription. Even oracle stems leave Basic Pitch as the dominant bottleneck.

mr_mt3_operational.decision: Keep MR-MT3 as RESEARCH/reference; persistent model reuse does not make CPU inference production-feasible.

challenger_survey.name: omnizart
challenger_survey.evidence: Maintained project with release v0.6.3 on 2026-05-31; project exposes a music transcription path and supports modern Python. Quality/runtime are not yet measured in this repository.
challenger_survey.next_gate: Only if #931 continues past baseline characterization: run on the failed full-mix domain using the same task-standard note metrics and record CPU latency/RSS.

challenger_survey.name: piano_transcription_inference
challenger_survey.evidence: The package is explicitly a piano transcription inference toolbox. Solo-piano routing is already resolved to TransKun under the current product decision.

challenger_survey.name: hFT-Transformer
challenger_survey.evidence: Official ISMIR 2023 implementation is an automatic piano transcription model evaluated on MAPS/MAESTRO and documents a Python 3.6-era environment; it does not fill #931's mixed/general domain gap.

challenger_survey.name: amt-tools
challenger_survey.evidence: Provides a customizable PyTorch AMT pipeline and paper implementations; the project describes itself as work-in-progress and has no packaged release/model that can replace the production engine by itself.

challenger_survey.name: MR-MT3
challenger_survey.code_license: MIT for measured mt3-infer code/weight repository metadata
challenger_survey.evidence: Already measured in-repo: materially better flat onset/note F1 than Basic Pitch on five Slakh excerpts, but persistent CPU inference remains about 79.8 seconds per 30-second excerpt at about 858 MB RSS.

decisions.guitar: KEEP. Recorded isolated guitar onset F1 is about 0.73 and threshold tuning adds less than 0.01. Duration/offset quality remains a limitation for notation-like uses.
decisions.full_mix: FAIL_DOMAIN. Basic Pitch has low note detection and duration quality on two independent synthetic-mixture evaluations. Do not describe this as solved general-music transcription.
decisions.threshold_tuning: REJECT_PRODUCTION_CHANGE. The sweep does not rescue full mixes and does not justify one global parameter change.
decisions.cleanup_heuristics: REJECT_AS_FIX. Existing cleanup removed zero notes on all ten real_audio_v1 clips; adding bespoke cleanup before a model challenger is not evidence-backed.
decisions.source_separation: REJECT_AS_MANDATORY_PREPROCESSOR. Real separation adds little and oracle stems still leave large transcription error.
decisions.next_experiment: If a further challenger run is justified, evaluate Omnizart first on the failed full-mix rows with the current canonical mir_eval note metrics and CPU/runtime accounting. Do not rerun piano-only challengers.

limitations: The recovered GuitarSet/BabySlakh note-with-offset metric used the repository's former fixed-50-ms offset rule; this artifact preserves that original semantic instead of converting it.
The task-standard Slakh result is a different five-track Slakh2100-redux subset, so its absolute scores are supporting domain evidence rather than a direct replacement for the BabySlakh numbers.

No new model inference was executed to create this consolidation artifact; it recovers measured repository evidence whose relevant Basic Pitch engine/inference/cleanup behavior remains unchanged at revalidation.
This slice does not establish performance on licensed commercial pop/electronic recordings or justify automatic genre/instrument routing.
